I have enough understanding. The bug is in `has_select_fields`: when `alias()` is used after `annotate()`, the annotation is moved to `self.annotations` but removed from `annotation_select_mask`, so `has_select_fields` returns False. Then `RelatedIn.get_prep_lookup` calls `clear_select_clause()` which wipes the select clause but leaves `self.annotations` intact, causing the subquery to select all annotation columns.

Let me fix `has_select_fields` to also consider `self.annotations`.
